maria_g: Heads up — during the MTL-6P bring-up + q4_nybble quant runs I started seeing the eval harness fail to parse tool outputs. The model emits something like: ' {\"result\": {\"action\": \'run\', \"args\": ...}} ' where the outer tool tag is split.
alex_w: Can you paste a minimal tokenization example? guessing it's the role/tool tag getting split by the tokenizer after quantization changes.
maria_g: Yup. Tokenizer output (post-tokenize) snippet:

samir: oof — can you show raw tokens? that helps.
maria_g: raw tokens: [301, 12, 9001, 110, 98, 27, 7, 404, 1102]
maria_g: original text: "<|tool_call|>{\"name\": \"run_command\"}"
maria_g: you can see <|tool_call|> becomes multiple tokens (110, 98, 27...) so downstream JSON mode logic doesn't recognize the sentinel and fails to switch into JSON parsing mode.
alex_w: This started after we switched the tokenizer merge ops in hf2rw for that model + applied the q4_nybble quant profile, right?
maria_g: Correct. Had a clean run on float32. The quantized graph seems to change how BPE merges interact with the special token boundaries.
samir: Two actionable items: 1) make the converter add a never-split special token into tokenizer.special_tokens (so HF tokenizer treats it as a single token) 2) add a unit test that tokenizes sentinel strings both before and after quantization simulation.

alex_w: Proposed quickfix in hf2rw conversion script:

```
# in hf2rw.py
if opts.add_tool_token:
    tokenizer.add_special_tokens({"additional_special_tokens": ["<|tool_call|>"]})
    tokenizer.train_new_from_iterator = False  # don't re-train merges
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(out_dir)
```

alex_w: Also update config.json mapping to include "tool_token": "<|tool_call|>" so runtime can read it.
maria_g: I pushed a draft branch (maria/tool-token-fix). Tests:
- tokenization idempotence test
- eval harness parse-test for tool outputs

samir: For safety we should also add a runtime guard: if the prefix sentinel token gets split, try to reassemble contiguous tokens matching the ASCII pattern of the sentinel before switching modes. fallback only; prefer token-level sentinel.

infra-bot: deploy-check results: CI failed on a lint in the new test but unit runs passed on linux/gpu:1

alex_w: Also calling out quantization nuance: q4_nybble sometimes coalesces byte-level patterns differently. We saw similar in older LLaMA variants where role tokens like "<|assistant|>" got split on tokenizers without never-split entries.
maria_g: Going to add a conversion flag `--ensure-never-split` and update docs in onboarding checklist: "always include role/tool sentinels as additional_special_tokens".

samir: Add one more thing: update rollback/rollout plan in Console. If tool-sentinel parse error rate > 0.5% for any model rollout, auto-fallback to previous flavor and open incident.
alex_w: I'll add a quick smoke eval in the rollout job that posts a metric `tool_sentinel_parse_fail` to tracing so Console can alert.
maria_g: Thanks. I've put the branch up, will follow up with a small PR shortly. Keeping this thread for coordination. :eyes:

eval-bot: Note: added a regression test in evals/parse_tests/test_tool_sentinels.py on branch maria/tool-token-fix
samir: Great, once PR is in let's run the quant+eval matrix. If that passes we can roll to canary. :shipit:
alex_w: Temporary mitigation: we could also map an alternate ASCII token (e.g., `<<TOOL>>`) in conversion for problematic models and teach runtime to accept both. But prefer never-split special tokens first.
maria_g: Agree. I'll add both in conversion but keep the primary as the never-split token. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
